$schemaNote: DM Validator schema for Delta Manager 0.7. Built from the official modding guide, the vanilla databases and editor-saved mods. Field names, types, ranges and allowed values only.
matching: Exact canonical value = ok. For enums with caseTolerant=true, a known variant (other case, accents, legacy or label form) = info, because vanilla data uses them too. Driving styles, sex and eventType must match exactly.

sponsorCategories.src: mod editor dropdown ↔ stored keys; vanilla 1995/2025/2026
sponsorCategories.note: The editor shows English labels but stores lowercase, partly French keys. Vanilla data also uses automobile, horlogerie, luxe and equipment, and mixed case. Category has no gameplay effect (guide §23.1).

bonusType.src: vanilla 1995/2025/2026 (all forms used, also mixed case); guide §23.1

characteristics.src: guide §18.6 (keys); labels as stored in vanilla 1995/2025/2026
characteristics.note: Mods store French labels; the guide documents internal keys. Stored labels for fetard_leger, fetard, fetard_enorme and fache_pluie are not known yet. Vanilla itself contains descriptive free-text traits.

reputation.note: README says 1-5, mods use up to 25; guide says reputationRequired has no effect. No range check until confirmed.

generalData.note: Paths seen in at least one editor-saved mod. Guide keys are also accepted.

sources.guide: Delta Manager modding guide (published by the developer on the official Discord)
sources.readme: README.md shipped in the game mods folder (older guide)
sources.vanilla: Vanilla 1995, 2025 and 2026 databases saved from the game editor
sources.observed: Field names seen in editor-saved community mods
